title: Protocol to measure inter-centrosome distance in adherent cells using epifluorescence microscopy
protocol: Replace the medium in each well of 12-well plates with 0.9 mL of prewarmed fresh culture medium.
Dilute 2 μL of Lipofectamine RNAiMax reagent in 50 μL of Opti-MEM medium.
Incubate the Lipofectamine RNAiMax solution for 5 minutes.
Dilute appropriate amounts of siRNAs in 50 μL of Opti-MEM medium.
Mix the Opti-MEM–Lipofectamine mix with the Opti-MEM–siRNA mix and incubate for 15 minutes.
Apply the mixed solution to RPE-1 cells in each well.
Maintain the cells in a humidified 37°C incubator for 36-48 hours until they reach 80% confluence.
Aspirate culture medium from the transfected cells.
Add approximately 1 mL of pre-chilled absolute methanol to the cells using a Pasteur pipette.
Incubate the cells in a -20°C freezer for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the methanol from the cells.
Rehydrate the cells by incubating with approximately 1 mL of PBS for 10 minutes at 21-24°C.
Briefly rinse the coverslips twice with ∼1 mL of PBST.
Incubate the coverslips with 0.5 mL of blocking buffer for 30 min at 21°C–24°C.
Dilute the rabbit polyclonal anti-CENP-F antibody (1:200 v/v) and mouse monoclonal anti-γ-tubulin antibody (1:500 v/v) in blocking buffer.
Load a 30-μL drop of the diluted antibodies on a piece of parafilm.
Place each coverslip on a drop of the antibody mixture by using forceps; cells are placed face down and therefore are in contact with the antibody mix.
Incubate at 21°C–24°C for 1 h.
Ensure that no air bubbles are present in the drop of antibody mix.
Transfer the coverslips to the wells of 12-well plates by using forceps; cells are placed face up.
Rinse the coverslips 5 times with ∼1 mL of PBST.
Dilute donkey anti-mouse IgG (Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated) and donkey anti-rabbit IgG (Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated) in PBST (1:1000).
Load a 30-μL drop of the diluted secondary antibodies on a piece of parafilm.
Place each coverslip on a drop of the antibody mixture by using forceps; cells are placed face down and therefore are in contact with the antibody mix.
Incubate at 21°C–24°C for 1 h in a dark box.
Transfer the coverslips back to 12-well plates; cells are placed face up.
Rinse coverslips thrice with 1 mL of PBST.
Rinse coverslips twice with 1 mL of PBS.
Incubate coverslips with Hoechst 33258 (1 mL diluted in PBS to 1 μM) at 21°C–24°C for 2 min to label DNA.
Rinse coverslips once with approximately 1 mL of PBS.
Load a drop of mounting medium (∼10 μL) on a microscope slide.
Transfer coverslips onto a Kimwipe using forceps, cells facing up.
Air-dry the coverslips for ∼1 min on the Kimwipe.
Place each coverslip slowly on a drop of the mounting medium by using forceps (cells facing down).
Remove excess mounting medium from the coverslip edge with Kimwipes.
Allow slides to dry at 37°C for 1 h or at 21°C–24°C for 12–24 h.
Ensure no air bubbles are present in the drop of mounting medium.

Acquire epifluorescence images by using DAPI (ultraviolet excitation filter), Alexa Fluor 488 (blue excitation filter), and Alexa Fluor 594 (green excitation filter) channels for imaging the signals of nuclear DNA, γ-tubulin, and CENP-F, respectively.
Identify late-G2 cells by positive staining of CENP-F at nuclei.
Determine the nuclear intensity of CENP-F by measuring the mean intensity within the nuclear region using the Contour graphic tool in ZEN software.
Derive the cytosolic intensity as the mean intensity of three 10-μm-diameter circles randomly positioned in the cytosolic region using the Circle graphic tool in ZEN software.
Record the fluorescence intensity of a non-cell area in the micrograph for background subtraction.
Score cells featuring a nuclear-to-cytosolic fluorescence-intensity ratio of >2.5 as late-G2 cells.
Measure inter-centrosome distances in both cells in late G2 and cells in stages preceding late G2.
Transfect RPE-1 cells with control siRNA or gas2l1-targeting siRNA (si-GAS2L1).
Measure inter-centrosome distances from late-G2 and prior-to-G2 cells in transfected RPE-1 cultures.
Manually position a circle surrounding centrosomes defined by γ-tubulin staining using ZEN software’s Circle graphic tool.
Mark the centers of circles as the centrosome centers with ZEN software.
Measure the distance between the centers of two centrosomes to obtain inter-centrosome distance using ZEN software's LINE tool.
